learning_objective: Students describe several different kinds of uniqueness among classmates and explain how valuing each one strengthens caring relationships and belonging.
specification:
Type: infographic **sim-id:** one-of-a-kind-classroom-gallery
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified Bloom Taxonomy: Understand (L2) Bloom Taxonomy Verb: describe, exemplify, compare Learning objective: Students describe several different kinds of uniqueness among classmates and explain how valuing each one strengthens caring relationships and belonging. Purpose: Show a warm, respectful gallery of eight diverse classroom characters, each with a unique trait, ability, family type, or interest, helping students see the many valid ways people can be different Layout: A friendly grid of eight illustrated classroom characters arranged around a shared center label reading "Our Class Is Full of One-of-a-Kind People" Characters to show (each with one notable, respectfully depicted trait): - A student who uses a wheelchair and loves basketball - A student who speaks two languages at home - A student raised by grandparents - A student who wears hearing aids and loves music - A student with curly red hair who loves painting - A student from a blended family who loves cooking with both households - A student who is quiet and loves reading alone at recess - A student who uses glasses and loves stargazing Interactive elements: - Hover or click each character to reveal a short, warm caption naming their unique trait and one thing they love - A second click reveals: "What makes [name] a great friend to have?" with one caring-relationship example - No character is marked as more or less "normal" than another; captions use equally warm, matter-of-fact language for each Visual style: Bright, friendly flat-style illustrations; diverse skin tones, abilities, family structures, and interests shown matter-of-factly, without singling any character out as different in a negative sense Color scheme: Each character highlighted in its own soft accent color when selected; shared warm neutral background Implementation: p5.js with click regions mapped to two-stage caption reveals; alternatively HTML/CSS grid with JavaScript hover/click handlers
